results.name: Runtime investigation mounts inside general analysis, once, with tracing off
Adopting emulator ROM copies identity without resetting game or replacing project
Start trace observes current state and explicit reset trace alone restarts game
Two snapshots expose changed state and selected address becomes an explicit watch
Comparison filters and paging remain bounded and preserve supplied query
PPU/APU events and resource masks display observations without recovered semantics
Originating code jumps require matching SHA even when ROM names are identical
Writes without instruction context cannot invent source-code links
Reset invalidates old UI observations and snapshots for the same ROM
Watch cap, address validation and removal are surfaced without mutation
Exports use Save As, preserve identity and bounded evidence; cancellation retains data
Untrusted ROM names and watch labels render as literal text
Keyboard input is isolated while preserving native field defaults
A changed emulator session during ROM adoption reports staleness
